name: Ray of Sickness
description: A ray of sickening greenish energy lashes out toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of your next turn.
notes: Ranged spell attack: 2d8 poison, and the target is poisoned (disadvantage on its attacks) until the end of its next turn.
Plenty of monsters shrug off poison.
